description: Alopecia areata — diffuse incipient aa, 28y Female.

clinicalRationale.whyPrimary: 28-year-old female with diffuse shed presenting on a background of prior areata history (incipient AA pattern) and confirmed alopecia areata history. The patchy-loss-marker and alopecia-areata-history signals together carry the strongest LLRs in the autoimmune cause definition; immune-dysregulation pathway leads at ≥0.60 activation. Protocol class is AUTOIMMUNE_AA — treatment focuses on immune quiescence and expectation setting for relapse/remission rather than miniaturization-style intervention.

whyNotCompetitors.androgen-driven-miniaturization: Pattern signal is structurally different (patchy vs gradient) and miniaturization pathway is exclusionary in autoimmune cause definition.
whyNotCompetitors.stress-driven-telogen-effluvium: Diffuse incipient AA can mimic TE, but the areata history signal carries leading weight.
whyNotCompetitors.inflammatory-scalp-dysfunction: Inflammatory scalp surface signals do not fire above background.
whyNotCompetitors.multifactorial-hair-loss: Single dominant pathway; multifactorial not met.

commonFailureModes.description: Incipient diffuse AA can be classified as TE without the alopecia-areata-history signal forcing autoimmune leadership.
